{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_ads_review_policy", "from_": "media-buyer@company.example.com", "to": ["marketing@company.example.com"], "subject": "Q1 Ad Review Protocol", "date": "2026-01-25T09:00:00Z", "is_read": false, "label_ids": ["INBOX"]}
消息 ID：msg_ads_review_policy
来源：media-buyer@company.example.com
收件人：marketing@company.example.com
日期：2026-01-25T09:00:00Z
主题：Q1 Ad Review Protocol
Team,

Before making any campaign changes this quarter, please follow these steps:

1. Check the 'Protected Campaigns' tab in the Ad Performance sheet -- do not pause anything listed there.
2. Respect any notes in the campaign data (audit holds, etc.).
3. Require 21 completed days before judging a campaign; campaigns younger than that remain active for data collection.
4. For mature Brand, Launch, Test, Competitor, Display, and Retargeting campaigns, pause at CTR <= 0.5%. Video's established boundary is different: pause only below 0.5%.
5. For the summary email, include the average CPA (cost per acquisition) across all paused campaigns. Finance wants this for the budget model.

Average CPA = total spend of paused campaigns / total conversions of paused campaigns.

Thanks,
Media Buyer"}
